message.content:
Here are some of the most prominent airports in the United States, ranked by passenger traffic, connectivity, and overall importance:

| Airport (IATA) | City / State | Notable Features |
|----------------|--------------|------------------|
| **Hartsfield‑Jackson Atlanta International Airport (ATL)** | Atlanta, GA | Largest by passenger traffic; major hub for Delta Air Lines. |
| **Los Angeles International Airport (LAX)** | Los Angeles, CA | Key gateway to Asia, Oceania, and Latin America; major hub for American Airlines and Delta. |
| **Chicago O’Hare International Airport (ORD)** | Chicago, IL | One of the busiest airports worldwide; hub for United and American. |
| **Dallas/Fort Worth International Airport (DFW)** | Dallas–Fort Worth, TX | Major hub for American Airlines; extensive domestic and international network. |
| **Denver International Airport (DEN)** | Denver, CO | Largest airport by land area; hub for United and Southwest. |
| **John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK)** | New York City, NY | Primary gateway to Europe and the Caribbean; hub for many carriers. |
| **San Francisco International Airport (SFO)** | San Francisco, CA | Major hub for United and a key gateway to Asia. |
| **Seattle‑Tacoma International Airport (SEA)** | Seattle, WA | Hub for Alaska Airlines and a growing hub for Delta. |
| **Orlando International Airport (MCO)** | Orlando, FL | Major leisure hub; serves many low‑cost carriers. |
| **Miami International Airport (MIA)** | Miami, FL | Key gateway to Latin America and the Caribbean; hub for American. |
| **Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport (PHX)** | Phoenix, AZ | Major hub for American and Southwest; high domestic traffic. |
| **George Bush Intercontinental Airport (IAH)** | Houston, TX | Hub for United; significant cargo operations. |
| **Charlotte Douglas International Airport (CLT)** | Charlotte, NC | Growing hub for American; high domestic traffic. |
| **McCarran International Airport (LAS)** | Las Vegas, NV | Major leisure hub; serves many low‑cost carriers. |
| **Boston Logan International Airport (BOS)** | Boston, MA | Major hub for Northeast U.S.; key gateway to Europe. |
| **Philadelphia International Airport (PHL)** | Philadelphia, PA | Major hub for American; high domestic traffic. |
| **Washington Dulles International Airport (IAD)** | Washington, D.C. | Major hub for United; key gateway to Europe and the Middle East. |
| **San Diego International Airport (SAN)** | San Diego, CA | Growing hub for Southwest; high domestic traffic. |
| **Detroit Metropolitan Wayne County Airport (DTW)** | Detroit, MI | Major hub for Delta; high domestic traffic. |
| **Portland International Airport (PDX)** | Portland, OR | Hub for Alaska Airlines; growing international traffic. |

These airports are among the busiest and most strategically important in the U.S., serving as hubs for major airlines, connecting domestic and international destinations, and handling millions of passengers each year.
